bootstrap.null_reference: The frozen 50,000-permutation primary null mean variance is held fixed across bootstrap replicates.
bootstrap.sampling: Within every class x frozen draft-capital bin cell, resample whole players with replacement to the original cell count.

h3_reconstruction.formula: Exact B6 V3 H3.O2 reconstruction from frozen B5/V5 contracts and B6 season artifacts.
h3_reconstruction.replay_validation: Every overlap with saved B6 2014-2023 top48 H3.O2 must agree to relative tolerance 1e-10.

non_gating_diagnostics.leave_one_class_out_influence: Recompute V2 scores/variance after dropping each class.

position_preserving_null.strata: position x broad NFL draft-capital bin

non_gating_diagnostics.qb_vs_non_qb: Report per-class QB/non-QB H3 totals and correlations with class score.

algorithm: Sample one 10-class score vector from the primary permutation null.
Draw 10 iid Normal(0,effect_sd) class effects and mean-center them.
Add effects to the sampled null score vector.
Evaluate p and excess-ratio gates against the frozen primary null variance distribution.
Evaluate the bootstrap-lower gate with 200 resamples of the 10 synthetic class scores; use the frozen primary null mean variance.
power_diagnostic.interpretation: Approximate diagnostic only; cannot rescue a primary failure. It only labels a neutral failure as adequately powered vs underpowered.
power_diagnostic.method: Class-score-level Monte Carlo calibrated to the frozen primary null score vectors.

primary_permutation.assignment: Independently shuffle the observed H3.O2 values within each frozen draft-capital bin across the fixed 188 class/bin slots.
primary_permutation.null_mean: arithmetic mean of all 50,000 null variances
primary_permutation.p_value: add-one one-sided P(null sample variance >= observed sample variance)
